scripts.db:backup: sh -c 'mkdir -p backups && TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) && docker compose exec -T mongo mongodump --archive > backups/backup-$TS.archive && cp backups/backup-$TS.archive backups/backup-latest.archive && echo "✅ Backup saved: backups/backup-$TS.archive (and backups/backup-latest.archive)"'
scripts.db:restore: sh -c 'docker compose exec -T mongo mongorestore --archive < backups/backup-latest.archive && echo "✅ Database restored from backups/backup-latest.archive"'
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build:api && npm run docker:build:admin && npm run docker:build:client
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.publish:patch: npm run ci && npm version patch --workspaces && npm publish --workspaces --if-present
scripts.publish:minor: npm run ci && npm version minor --workspaces && npm publish --workspaces --if-present
scripts.publish:major: npm run ci && npm version major --workspaces && npm publish --workspaces --if-present
